billed_drg.title: Major Hip and Knee Joint Replacement or Reattachment of Lower Extremity with MCC

secondary_diagnoses.description: Presence of right artificial knee joint

inpatient_procedures.description: Replacement of Right Knee Joint with Synthetic Substitute, Cemented, Open Approach

medical_record_excerpt: 69-year-old female admitted for elective right total knee arthroplasty. Surgery performed without complication. Post-op Day 1: Patient had a single blood pressure reading of 168/92 mmHg post-anesthesia recovery. Given 1 dose of oral Amlodipine 5mg. Subsequent blood pressures normalized (130s/80s). Discharged on post-op day 3 in stable condition to home physical therapy.

policy_sources: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, Section III (Reporting Additional Diagnoses)

admission_review.rationale: Elective total knee arthroplasty for primary osteoarthritis of the right knee with documented inpatient stay.

diagnosis_reviews.rationale: Single elevated reading treated with one oral dose; no documented intensive monitoring, IV therapy, or end-organ evaluation to support reporting hypertensive urgency.
